name: lateral-slam-battle-rope
instructions:
1. Setup in a good athletic base position with your knees slightly bent, feet shoulder width apart, and both hands holding the ropes.
2. In a wave like motion, lift both arms overhead and generate full extension of the arms and hips before slamming the ropes side to side.
3. Repeat for the desired time, duration, or reps.
